name: DirExplorer
description: Directory & codebase exploration tools (Grep, Glob) for rapid file discovery and regex search; files are read with the core `read_file` tool with workspace-aware path resolution.
brief: You can explore any codebase with the `Grep` (regex search) and `Glob` (file pattern matching) tools, and read files with `read_file`. These tools are workspace-aware — relative paths resolve against the current project directory.
author: Evonic
